summary: Enhance your skills in water management for climate change adaptation. Join our training course and learn effective strategies for sustainable practices.
lede: Water Management in Climate Change Adaptation gives professionals a practical way to assess water risks, interpret climate signals, improve allocation decisions, and protect vital water sources. It supports those managing municipal supply, irrigation, industrial water use, WASH programmes, catchment protection, or climate adaptation projects. Build resilient infrastructure strategies, weigh trade-offs clearly, and connect adaptation actions to measurable results. You will learn to prioritise, justify, implement, and report on climate-smart water management for daily operations and long-term planning.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals who regularly plan, implement, or oversee water-related interventions under climate risk. These include corporate, public sector, and NGO professionals tasked with ensuring water security and reducing climate vulnerability.
audience: Water utility managers and technical teams
Public sector staff in water, environment
Irrigation, agriculture, and water-user association leaders
ESG, sustainability, and climate adaptation leads
modules: Foundations of Water Management in Climate Change Adaptation
Understanding Climate Risks to Water Systems
Water Demand Management Under Climate Pressure
Water Supply Planning and Water Balance Tools
Water Quality and Public Health in a Changing Climate
Financing and Prioritizing Water Adaptation Investments
Governance, Stakeholder Coordination, and Water Allocation
Monitoring, Evaluation, and Reporting for Water Adaptation
Capstone: Climate-Smart Water Adaptation Action Plan
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of water management concepts and some experience in planning or managing water-related projects. Familiarity with climate change impacts on water systems is beneficial but not mandatory.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
